Title: How to remove default value for column?
Description: Hello. Here's a table for example:
```sql
CREATE TABLE test.table1
(
        EventDate Date,
        Id Int32,
        Value String default 'strstrstr'
)
Engine = MergeTree()
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(EventDate)
ORDER BY Id;
```

I can modify default value for "Value" column like: `ALTER TABLE test.table1 MODIFY COLUMN Value DEFAULT 'mystring'`
But how can I remove this default value? Even if I execute `ALTER TABLE test.table1 MODIFY COLUMN Value DEFAULT ''`, it just defaults to an empty string.
And also I cannot do this for types like Int32, because this will throw an error on future SELECT
